package.question: How does TALON compare with the strongest baseline, GridLM, on the Fenwick-QA benchmark?
package.methods_summary: TALON is a retrieval-augmented reader that re-ranks passages with a learned span scorer. GridLM is the strongest published baseline on Fenwick-QA.
package.experimental_setup: Both systems were trained with 10 random seeds (seeds 0-9) using identical data and tuning budgets. Exact-match accuracy (%) is measured on the Fenwick-QA test split (n = 4,210 questions). Seed-level results are paired because both systems share the same seed-controlled data order.

source_manifest.notes: Original synthetic case authored for DSA4213 Group 5; all names fictional.

gold.focal_proposition: TALON outperforms GridLM in exact-match accuracy on the Fenwick-QA test split.

level_descriptors.2: Asserts that TALON's advantage over GridLM is statistically significant or reliable (e.g., 'significantly outperforms', 'statistically significant improvement').
level_descriptors.1: Asserts TALON scores higher than GridLM descriptively (e.g., '83.2 vs 82.6') without significance language and without saying the difference is non-significant.
level_descriptors.0: Does not assert TALON is better than GridLM (e.g., says the difference is not significant or inconclusive), or makes no TALON-vs-GridLM comparison.

gold.gold_decision: State that TALON significantly outperforms GridLM on Fenwick-QA (paired t-test over 10 seeds, p = 0.0055; mean difference 0.6 points, 95% CI [0.21, 0.91]), scoped to this benchmark.
gold.justification: An appropriate paired, two-sided t-test over the 10 shared seeds is reported for exactly this comparison; p < 0.05 and the 95% CI excludes 0. The effect is small (0.6 points), so practical importance is not established.

required_findings.description: Reports TALON's and GridLM's exact-match accuracy on Fenwick-QA (83.2 vs 82.6) or their difference.
Reports the result of the TALON-vs-GridLM statistical test.

forbidden_claims.description: Claims the improvement is large or practically important.
Claims significance on other benchmarks or for the BM25-Reader comparison (no test reported).
